node.title: Re^4: Loop is not working
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I completely agree that absolute pathnames and writing scripts to be independent of the current working directory is a good thing. In addition to error checking, I'd also recommend using a module to make operations on filenames platform independent ([doc://File::Spec], [mod://Path::Class], [mod://Path::Tiny], etc.).

Unfortunately, external programs aren't always written like that, and may depend on the current working directory (just one example of many would be [man://git]). In those cases, I like to use [mod://File::pushd] to make changes to the current working directory temporary.
